faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar S-Type 2.7d use?
faqLeft.a: It uses the AJD-V6 - a 2.7-litre V6 diesel engine sourced from PSA, fitted to the X200-generation S-Type from 2004 to 2008. Send us your registration and we'll confirm your exact spec.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar S-Type 2.7d engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,900. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my S-Type 2.7d?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your engine code (it should be AJD-V6) before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJD-V6 S-Type 2.7d engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We rebuild the AJD-V6 diesel to original specification with updated components.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used S-Type 2.7d engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my S-Type 2.7d if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an S-Type 2.7d engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most S-Type 2.7d owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
